info.name: Fraudulent Vendor Bank-Change Detection Workflow
info.description:
Complete API collection for the Fraudulent Vendor Bank-Change Detection Workflow.

**How to run it**

1. Import `Fraudulent_Vendor_Environment.postman_environment.json` and select it.
2. Start the backend on http://localhost:9090 with the bootstrap enabled so the demonstration users exist.
3. Run folder 1 first: it captures a bearer token per role into collection variables.
4. Run folders 2 to 10 in order. Each folder's requests chain through collection variables captured by the ones before it.

**Tokens**

The collection authorises with `{{activeToken}}` by default. Set it to the role a request needs - several negative tests exist precisely to be run with the *wrong* role, and each one says which token to use in its description.

Every account reference in this collection is synthetic.

item.name: 7. Payment holds
item.description: Release is its own authorised operation. Nothing in the approval or override workflow releases a hold.

request.description: Active holds across all payments.
Conditions are rechecked at release time; the actor, time and justification are recorded.
A justification of at least ten characters is required.
Run with the Administrator's token: releasing is Accounts Payable's alone.

item.name: NEGATIVE: releasing the same hold twice

request.description: A released hold cannot be released again.

item.name: 8. Emergency overrides
item.description: Requested by Accounts Payable, decided by an Administrator. Authorises a documented cooling-off exception and nothing else.

request.description: Requires completed dual approval and a request in cooling-off.
Approval brings the cooling-off deadline forward. Dual approval still stands, revalidation still runs, holds are untouched.
Filterable by status.
